A simple dish made by cooking chunks of fresh fish on a skewer.|Cooking (Interface)|AoC}} are recurring [[Meal]]s in {{TLoZ Series}}. ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Fish Skewers are made by [[Cooking]] one to three [[Fish]] together in a [[Cooking Pot]]. Regular versions of these Skewers can only be made by either using [[Hyrule Bass]]es or [[Sanke Carp]]s or using Fish with contradictory effects. They heal [[Link]] when eaten. Fish Skewers are simple dishes made by cooking fresh chunks of Fish on a skewer. Based on the type of Fish used, several different variations of Fish Skewers exist: * '''Hearty Fish Skewer''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hearty Fish Skewer}}
Restores your health and temporarily increases your maximum hearts.
A simple dish made by cooking chunks of fresh fish on a skewer.|Inventory|BotW}} Made using [[Hearty Bass]], [[Hearty Salmon]]s, or other hearty [[Ingredient]]s. When eaten, they will replenish all of Link's [[Heart]]s and temporarily increase his maximum Hearts. * '''Energizing Fish Skewer''':{{Cite|{{Big|Energizing Fish Skewer}}
Instantly refills some of your Stamina Wheel.
A simple dish made by cooking chunks of fresh fish on a skewer.|Inventory|BotW}} Made using [[Staminoka Bass]]es or other energizing Ingredients. Eating one of these Skewers will refill a portion of Link's [[Stamina Wheel]]. * '''Hasty Fish Skewer''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hasty Fish Skewer}}
Grants a low-level movement-speed boost.
A simple dish made by cooking chunks of fresh fish on a skewer.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding speed-boosting Ingredients. If they are eaten, Link's movement speed will be boosted temporarily. * '''Spicy Fish Skewer''':{{Cite|{{Big|Spicy Fish Skewer}}
Grants low-level cold resistance.
A simple dish made by cooking chunks of fresh fish on a skewer.|Inventory|BotW}} Made using [[Sizzlefin Trout]]s or other spicy Ingredients. They grant Link one level of [[Cold Resistance]] when eaten. * '''Electro Fish Skewer''':{{Cite|{{Big|Electro Fish Skewer}}
Grants low-level electricity resistance.
A simple dish made by cooking chunks of fresh fish on a skewer.|Inventory|BotW}} Made using [[Voltfin Trout]] or other electricity-related Ingredients. Eating one grants Link one level of [[Shock Resistance]]. * '''Mighty Fish Skewer''':{{Cite|{{Big|Mighty Fish Skewer}}

A simple dish made by cooking chunks of fresh fish on a skewer.|Inventory|BotW}} Made using [[Mighty Carp]]s, [[Mighty Porgy|Mighty Porgies]], or other attack-boosting Ingredients. Consuming one of these will increase Link's attack power for a short period of time. * '''Tough Fish Skewer''':{{Cite|{{Big|Tough Fish Skewer}}

Eating one grants Link a single additional Heart to shield him from [[Gloom]]. ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} The recipe for Chilly Fish Skewer is earned by completing the [[Quest]] "[[Superb Fish Dish]]". It is made using four [[Stealthfin Trout]]s. However, it can be lowered to three through the completion of "[[Hungry Hunches]]". When prepared before a [[Challenge]] or [[Scenario]], the [[Warrior]]s will take 50% less damage from [[Fire]]. {{Noncanon|End}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:AoC Chilly Fish Skewer Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Icon for Chilly Fish Skewers ==See Also== {{See Also| * Copious Seafood Skewers * Fish and Mushroom Skewer * Food * Meal * Seafood Skewer }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Health Restoring Items, Meals, Seafood, Skewers |items= BotW, TotK }}
